Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['You taking tomorrow off?', "Twenty-one, huh? Maybe it's a good time to send off that letter of recommendation for officer training.", "You're past due for a promotion, Farron. Think of your sister, and your future. And, uh, keep your nose out of trouble.", 'Yeah. Nothing good will come of it. Nothing but grief.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["I am fal'Cie. My name is Barthandelus. Voice of the Sanctum and Lord-Soverign of the Cocoon fal'Cie. Your kind feared the darkness, so we gave you light.You begged us for the Purge, and did it not come to pass? Now your spurn our counsel? You must learn your place!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['When it comes to Pulse, who could claim to know anything? I need the truth, for the sake of Cocoon.', "Those are the Sanctum's methods. The public fears what it doesn't know. It's grown tired of living in constant terror of these treats from the World below. So, the Sanctum devised a plan for you l'Cie.", "A public execution. The people don't know any better. Strike down the phantoms before their eyes, and they sleep like babes.", "So the Primarch can stand in judgment of the villainous l'Cie...with their execution as the climax. The people will cheer their demise, and fal'Cie dominion will be undisputed.", 'Yes, but it also presents an opportunity.', 'I put you on the path. That was my focus.', "Since long before we met. I did my best to assist you as bid by the Sanctum fal'Cie. Now do you understand? The fal'Cie haved watched over you, guiding your every step. The 'luck' that saved you time and again was a deliberate machination. Why, you may ask? The Primarch--or should I say Barthandelus--is crafting you into the instruments of Cocoon's demise.", "The entity responsible for creating both humans and fal’Cie. Long ago, the Maker departed the world, leaving the two races behind. In a sense, human and fal'Cie are brothers--orphaned by the same parent. As for the humans, they forgot the order imposed by the Marker. They began to war among themselves for the first time in history. The fal'Cie focused on recalling their lost deity, and returning the world to its former glory. This purpose lies in the heart of all their actions. Calling back the Maker requires a fitting sacrifice.", "Ironic, isn't it? The only thing I wanted was a moment of triumph. How it ends isn't important. Just do what you know is right. Trust yourselves.", "My dream is but a fal'Cie's fancy now. End it.", "The public fears what it doesn't know... Strike down the phantoms before their eyes, and they sleep like babes.", "A l'Cie tied to an inescapable Focus - a slave of destiny. I'd lost hope. I'd all but given up dreams of freedom.", 'When it comes to Pulse, who could claim to know anything? I need the truth, for the sake of Cocoon.', "The public fears what it doesn't know. It's grown tired of living in constant terror of these treats from the world below. So, the Sanctum devised a plan for you l'Cie.", 'I put you on the path. That was my Focus.', "I did my best to assist you as bid by the Sanctum fal'Cie.", "A shadow of a dream from when I was human. It was change I craved, and once I'd built the influence to make things happen, there was change. I gained all the power I could hope for, but was a puppet with no will to wield it. It wasn't the fal'Cie that changed, it was me.", "I'm here of my own accord, not by fal'Cie. Seeing you fight brought it all back. Brought back that future I once strove for. I, too, will challenge my fate.", 'I will set you free!', "The only thing I wanted was a moment of triumph. How it ends isn't important. Just do what you know is right. Trust yourselves.", 'People of Cocoon. My fellow citizens. We have survived the twilight, and gather now to welcome the dawn on which we decide our fate. Many are lessons we have learned during our long night of hardship and sacrifice. And now we face choices, which must be made as our hearts dictate, and not abandoned to uncared chance, Let us forge ahead with unflinching courage and honor the fallen with action. With these hands we shape the future.', 'I shall set you free!', 'My Triumph is near!', 'You are mine!', 'No more words!', "The fal'Cie have no hold over me!", 'On your Guard!', 'My Will is my own!', 'My Will is my Strength!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['Hey, Dad.', "Well, you're never happy. You never smile. So here what I wished: I wished that you'd cheer up and be like your old self again.", 'What for, dad?', 'Daddy, I found you! Daddy! Got you!', 'Because you promised!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['Then take a nap.', "Sure, and when we're taking a nap, you can save everyone.", 'We got trouble!', 'Yeah?', 'Something on your mind? You got plenty of time for thinking on the way, hero.', 'You got it. Say hi to the missus for me. You go skirt-chasing, I take care of the kids. Some husband!', 'Better be home cooking!', 'Gate got ya beat? Hero?']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["This crisis threatens the entirety of Cocoon, my child. You agree that standing at the fore is a leader's charge.", 'It also affords a splendid view of the impeding execution.', 'Desperate times demand flexibility. Code white.', 'What else does one do with tools?', "Cocoon is a factory, built by fal'Cie. A factory for the mass production of human thralls.", "What can mere men do? Without our help, death is all of which you're capable. You saw the fools. A mindless mob drunk on fear of a few l'Cie.", "L'Cie? You mean me? Oh, child, perish the thought. I am more that that!", 'Ease is not the issue. You have not fought to win. You should know quite well already the sure way of dispatching our kind. Ragnarok.', "Pitiful l'Cie, you've forgotten your Focus. Ragnarok is the beast one of you must become in order to lay waste to Cocoon. You have had the dream. One among you will become that monstrosity, defeat Orphan, and destroy Cocoon.", "Allow me to help you see the truth of things. The moment you arrived, your friend wept crystal tears. That's because her Focus required that you be brought together. That girl did nothing but assemble the tools for Cocoon's destruction.", 'Did it never occur to you? Or did you simply refuse to countenance the thought? If you will not face the truth, then face the peril of your plight.', "Run, l'Cie. See how stark really is!", "You betray your fal'Cie to chase after dreams and shadows. The world you claim to wish to protect now faces the end of days with no hope of salvation.", "Oh, it won't be fal'Cie who desstoy her. For centuries now, Cocoon has provided generously for its human inhabitants' every want and need. Coddled them, one might even say.The result being their deep seated gear and hatred of change and all things alien. Fed, nurtured, and ready to detonate at the slightest spark. The seeds of destruction take root, even now.", 'I resigned, appointing Raines as Primarch in my stead.', 'The puppet is restrung to serve my needs, yes.', 'The time has come. [laughs evilly] All me to extend my invitation. To save a people beyond salvation, there is only Ragnarok.', 'Cocoon suffers. Release her from the pain.', "Can you halt the Cavalry's charge? Filled with righteousness, they will slaughter Orphan in the name of freedom. Your only recourse will be to deliver them death, swift and certain.", "We will see about that. I shall savor the demise of Cocoon from atop the highest seat in all of Eden. You, too, should hurry along to the heart of our grand capital. Your loved ones miss you so. Come, l'Cie. Fulfill your destiny!", "Life's spark shines on, once freed from its fleshy shroud.", 'Dreams, meanwhile, shatter in a flash.', "There's no denying the enormity of the strain the Purge placed on us all. But, given the tens of millions of lives at stake, there truly was no alternative.", "In all the centuries since the War of Transgression, Cocoon has been spared Pulse aggression, and prospered for it. It is essential that we maintain this peace. That is the Sanctum's focus. We will continue employing every resource available to combat these threats to the harmony of our society.", 'What else does one do with tools?', "Without our help, death is all of which you're capable. You saw the fools. A mindless mob drunk on fear of a few l'Cie.", "l'Cie? You mean me? Oh child, perish the thought. I am more than that!  I am fal'Cie. My name is Barthandelus. Voice of the Sanctum and Lord-Sovereign of the Cocoon fal'Cie. Your kind feared the darkness, so we gave you light. You begged us for the Purge. and did it not come to pass? Now your spurn our counsel? You must learn your place!", 'Will you enjoy the festivities beside me or perhaps...  Greet the end here in the land where it all began ?', 'If you truly seek salvation, you will obey!', "This is the power of a fal'Cie.", 'Come...', "What can mere l'Cie do?", 'You are ignorant of your place.', 'I am most disappointed.', 'You waste your time.', 'Is that all you got?', 'I am the harbinger of death!', 'Yield!', 'Witness my power!', 'You will taste agony!', 'You will know true terror!', "Now you will bow to the fal'Cie!", 'Submit!', 'The World begs for salvation.', "Piteous l'Cie!", 'Perhaps, some of this?', 'Such marvelous strength!', 'Can you endure this?', 'You struggle in vain!', 'Fulfill your Focus.', 'Rip! Die! Kill!', 'Rrrrraaaaagghhgh!', 'Rrrrraaaaagghhgh!', 'Rrrrraaaaagghhgh!', 'Release...At last, release!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["Mom, you still believe in that kind of stuff? Wishing on fireworks, really? That's for little kids.", 'You. What did you wish for?', "Why? It's better like this. We don't need him.", 'O—okay...', 'Hey! Wait!', "What did you expect? Even soldiers know not to go near the fal'Cie. You become a Pulse l'Cie, and you're finished.", "Haven't you heard, Miss...?", 'Huh?', "What's my—? Pulse is hell on earth!", 'Get off me.', "What's wrong with you? Why do you want to help a l'Cie?! They're the enemy! How can you save a l'Cie and not...and not.... That's insane!", "l'Cie who full their Focus are transformed into crystal and gain eternal life.", "So this...is the fal'Cie...?", "He used magic! You used the power of a l'Cie! The fal'Cie cursed us! We're l'Cie now!", "Why me? I don't even know you, but you have to go and attack that thing?!", "Just leave me alone! It's your fault-- It's you fault my-- You could've-- All of this is your and Serah's fault!", "Wait, but I don't get it. If you're not PSICOM, then why did you board the train?", "You're telling me that you got on that train so you can save your sister? That's crazy. I could never do something like that.", "That night, they found the fal'Cie in the Bodhum Vestige. The next day, soldiers sealed the town and we couldn't get back to Palumpolum. They forced us onto the train with everyone else. My mom, she was frantic. She wanted to get us home, so she tried to fight. She got tricked, by Snow! He used her!", "Let him worry. Why should I care? He doesn't.", 'As long as you have a goal, you can fight?', 'I know that. But-I need to be stronger. Lightning?', "Lightning! Your brand looks different. Was that an Eidolon? Like l'Cie can summon?", "Actually...Why don't you let me take point?", "It's not a question of can or can't.", "They don't seem like they're even looking for us. I mean, we're l'Cie and we're on the loose.", "So the other soldiers don't know about us. Right?", "Do you think he's still alive?", "It's irresponsible.", "Strategy. Good. I'll take anything to help me get through this. I'll call it 'Operation Nora'.", "My mother's name.", "That's the city's food-production fal'Cie. Name's Carbuncle. That's one of our enemies, being Sanctum and all.", "I think people have enough reason to hate us, don't you.", "Look at us: Pulse l'Cie, using a Sanctum fal'Cie to tell where we're going. Sort of strange.", "You think? They protect us, nurture us. They take care of, well, normal people. They treat us like we're special, almost like...Like we're pets!", "Hope? There is no hope. Not for l'Cie.", "It's my name, not who I am.", "Don't say it! Don't say his name. It bring everything back. I keep playing it in my head, what happened to her. And then I see his stupid face and--and he's smiling. How can he smile when she's dead? I know! There nothing I can't do. I hate knowing that. No matter what happens, she's not coming back! When I was fighting, there was no time to think about it. It felt good just to give in. But now you start talking about hope...", "I'm sorry. I'm messed up.", "I'm a l'Cie. I had to.", "You think it's stupid.", 'He was...he was smiling!', "We don't have any!", "A l'Cie's only hope is a quick death!", 'I wanted to ask you something.', 'You say you want a family. What if, what if they were taken from you?', "And what if you couldn't? What if you who was to blame?", 'Snow? What do you plan to do? I need to know.', "And what if that gets people around you involved? What happens when your actions end up ruining someone's life? What if someone dies? What then, Snow? How do you pay for what you've done?", "So that's it? People die and you just run away?", "There are no answers! You're running from what you deserve!", 'The same fate!', "You told me before that you couldn't.", "The wind--it's dying down.", 'If we pull this off, it will be a miracle.', 'Do you really think our Focus is what Dysley said it is?', "It's almost like Dysley want it to come true.", 'Think of it as training for the fight ahead.', "All right. I'm in.", "If nothing, we know Cocoon is safe for the time being. I'd say it's worth going to take a look.", "I made him a promise.I promised him to keep going, and do what I had to. He said only I would know what that was. The world's full of lies. There's no way of knowing what's right. All we can do believe on ourselves It's easy to sit back and let people trick you. Like how the Sanctum had us all thinking that a l'Cie was some sort of monster. I'm done with their lies. Fal'Cie, this whole Focus thing. From here on out I use my own eyes. Think. And act. I might not make all the right choices. But as long as I'm the one who decided what to do, there's nothing regret.", "Oerba--the place it all began. The place where the Pulse fal'Cie lay dreaming. Vanille and Fang's home. Just maybe... it will be the place where we find the answers we're looking for.", "[starts crying]: But that what scares me! I don't...I don't want see you get hurt because of me. It would be better for everyone if I just stayed behind.", 'You mean, that came from me?', 'Huh? Oh, I, uh--I was just thinking.', "I was just taking it all in. The sky here, the trees, the sunlight, the smells..When I was on Cocoon, I never dreamed a place like this could even exist. But now? Here I am, on Pulse. If I hadn't gone to those fireworks, if I hadn't been sitting in that same train car during the Purge...If anything had been different, I'd never have had a chance to see this.", 'Uh..really? I...When did I do that?', 'What does that even mean?', 'Wait! Stop already!', "I don't know. It's weird, like voices in my head.", "He's bluffing to scare us off. Let's just go with that! Come on! We can do this!", 'So I guess that means there are still more monsters like one out there.', "Let's keep on looking. That's what we came here for. We all agreed, and now we're here.", 'Which is your house?', "Lightning, you told me on Cocoon. It's not a question of can or can't. We just do it. That's our only choice this time, Maybe it won't do much. Maybe only one person will listen to us. But even then, isn't trying better than doing nothing?", "That's how Light gets around!", "Your destiny...We'll decide our own destiny!", "Then, you knew the fal'Cie were using us?", "We'll do it for everyone. Fal'Cie rule ends here.", "Yeah. They don't work wonders. They play tricks.", "My brand! It's gone!", "Wow, you don't waste time, do you?", "It's all or nothing!", 'Come on, Light!', 'Maybe we should try something else?', "Now it's my turn.", 'Careful now!', 'Did you miss me, mom?', 'Why me?', "I'm sorry, I can't do this...", 'Alexander! Need your help, big guy!', "Okay, Let me up! Okay, let's do this!", 'Nothing can stop us!', "Maybe there's hope for us after all.", "I'll show you hope!", "I'm not giving in!", "I'll fight and I'll survive!", 'Try this on for size!', "Now's our chance.", 'Clear the way! Fire!', 'See you next time.', 'One down!', 'Just like I planned it.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["The capture of undesirables. It seems that was your son's Focus. Dajh fulfilled it admirably, and served Cocoon in the process. You should be proud of him, Mr. Katzroy.", "We enhanced the survellance footage from the energy plant. Those are the Pulse l'Cie behind what happened. The picture's a little grainy, but I'm sure you recognized that. You've spent so much time together.", "Yes. That young lady's terrorist assault at the Euride Gorge is the reason Dajh was made a l'Cie. Ironic, isn't it? The very girl you're protecting...is the one who stole your son.", "You should be proud. Your son's a hero. The boy who saved Cocoon. We'll erect a memorial in Eden and put his crystal on display.", "Do be careful with those. For every task, there's a perfect tool.", "We didn't expect to see you here in person, Your Eminence.", 'Wholeheartedly.', "No! Damn l'Cie.", 'Make it rain!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["What's to dread? PSICOM's nothing but a whole bunch of bluster and bullying. They got nothing on NORA.", 'Hey, what about me?!', 'Pretty lame.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['Sir, for my birthday, sir. My sister, she insisted on it.', 'Lieutenant...', 'Out of PSICOM business, you mean.', "You became a l'Cie, so now you're gonna marry this idiot? And you think I'm gonna buy that? Full points for originality. But, don't forget. If you really are a l'Cie, it's my job to deal with you.", 'This is ridiculous. Worst birthday ever.', "You're kidding me? She gets made l'Cie, and you pop the question?", 'Who are you calling "sister"?! Is this some kind of a joke?!', 'How practical.', 'So direct me, let me. I want to be Purged.', 'Then I quit.', 'I volunteered.', 'You want quiet, you better take the next train.', 'I a soldier.', "Better to die than get sent to Pulse. It's hell without the brimstone.", 'He wants to kill us without a fight.', "Pulse fal'Cie. My 'angle'. I'm after the fal'Cie.", 'Still happy you tagged along?', 'That was the idea.', "Sanctum logic. They conjured up the Purge to eliminate a threat. I mean—why carry the danger all the way to Pulse? Why not just stamp it out here? Execution masquerading as exile. That's all the Purge ever was.", "Why didn't I listen?", 'It was me. This is my fault.', 'Cover your ears.', "I'm so sorry...Please let me in. Please?", 'My sister...', "She's a l'Cie.", "The fal'Cie has her captive. But I'll find her.", "Just say it! Any l'Cie...Anyone who might even become a l'Cie should be wiped off the face of Cocoon! It's people like you that the started the Purge in the first place.", 'Save Cocoon? Serah, is that your Focus?', "Somehow, I'll think of something.", 'Serah!', "What the hell's gotten into you?! Open your eyes and face reality!", 'Fine, you go on begging! Like this thing gives a damn what we want!', "It's this thing's fault the Purge started, and it's people are dying. Serah told us to save Cocoon. That means this thing needs to die!", '[takes up her weapon] Right.', "l'Cie to the last...", "Cut the crap. Their grunts might be green, but PSICOM's elites are cold-blooded beasts. They hit the field and it's game over.", "What about our focus? What happened to banding together to save the world? It's that what you promised? Now you want to forget it all and die here? Snow? You're nothing but talk.", 'Great job so far.', "The Purge is PSICOM's baby. Our military is split into two arms: the Public Security and Intelligence Command, known as PSICOM, and the Guardian Corps. I was Guardian Corps, Bodhum security regiment.", 'For Serah. I had to rescue Serah before they transported the Vestige to Pulse, and out of my reach. My only chance to save her was to join the Purge.', "It's not a question of can or can't. There are some things in life you just do.", 'Got me. Not even the Corps has access to intel on Pulse. Soldiers in the field fight blind.', "Target's a target.", 'You can stay alive.', "Keep running—it's die or turn Cie'th. There's no place for l'Cie to hide. No…they want a fight? Let's take it to the Sanctum's door!", "No. That's for damn sure. It started with Serah. The fal'Cie took her. Now I'm a l'Cie. And the Sanctum's hunting me, an enemy of the state. But who's pulling their strings? A fal'Cie. Eden. Cocoon's sustainer and guiding light. It probably ordered the Purge, too. Pulse and Sanctum fal'Cie? They're all the same. And we're all the same to them: expendable. I'm not dying a fal'Cie slave.", "With me, it'll be fight after fight. I don't know how it'll end. It's anybody's guess.", 'Call me Light.', "Magic and mumbo-jumbo. I must've hit my head on that Purge train.", 'Right. We press forward. I take point, you watch our backs.', 'Can you handle it?', "Now you're learning.", "PSICOM's keeping it all under wraps. They don't want their failure publicized. Better they lose us than their pride.", "Right. They don't know anything about any fugitives.", "You mean Snow? He's too stubborn to die. And that's his best quality. He's arrogant and chummy from the get-go. He thinks he's everybody's pal. Never liked him much. He leads a bunch of kids--gang called 'NORA'.", "It's a stupid acronym. Their little code. Stands for 'No Obligations, Rules, or Authority'. Must be nice.", "Don't touch anything. Control your emotions. If you want to survive, you forget about sympathy. How can I explain? Think of it like a strategy. Focus on your ultimate goal and shut out everything else. Still your mind. Move on instinct. Let doubt take over, and despair will cripple you.", 'NORA?', 'Your revenge?', "Kill him, and cut off the food supply. That'll make us popular.", "Yeah, you're probably right. Hungry people make for angry people.", "Not really. We've relied on them our our lives. The food we eat, the light and water, it's all from the fal'Cie. You know, I think Cocoon was really built for them. The rest of us, we're just leeches. Parasites.", "Like pets. To them, we are just pets. That's it. Now it makes sense. I've been so blind. I was born into a fal'Cie world, raised on a fal'Cie leash. It was the only life I know how to live. When it was taken from me, I was completely lost. Without a master to follow - my life had no purpose. Hope, listen to me. This l'Cie curse, it took everything. My future. My dreams. I didn't want to think. So I fought instead. As long as I was fighting, nothing else was real I was running away. And you, Hope... You got swept along with me.", 'Operation Nora is over.', "I don't know yet. But I do know we can't lose hope.", "There's you.", "I was just like you. My parents died. I have to be strong for Serah, so I thought I needed to forget my past. And I became Lightning. I thought by changing my name, I could change who I was. I was just a kid. Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys. Serah tried to tell me, but I wouldn't listen. I threatened her. The only one who believed her was Snow.", "No...It's my fault.", "I'm not your sister.", 'Who are you?', "Hey, Fang. The others are safe, right? If any of us caught, they'd make an announcement.", "'These Cocoon people' have spent centuries under fal'Cie, in constant fear of a Pulse invasion. If it weren't for Serah, I'd have been out there too. Hunting l'Cie. Would have been nothing but targets to me.", 'All part of the plan.', "Yeah, it's stopping. And we're decelerating. They up to something?", 'Not to me. That? They we can do something about.', "Because when we kill, we're a step closer to Vanille. How's that?", "He's serious, We're gonna take down the the Sanctum and give Cocoon back to the people. The fal'Cie have called the shots for long enough.", 'You got it!', "If they only knew a l'Cie was filling their glasses...!", "About Serah's Focus? Not like you to second-guess yourself.", 'What about your plan to save Cocoon? Either way, your faith in Serah was strong. That strength got you this far.', "Yeah. You tried so hard to convince us that you even fooled yourself. You've been a total idiot. But still...It saved me. You trusted Serah. Let that faith drive you. It even made me want to believe.", 'An Ark?', "Okay, so, I get it. Dysleys's goal is to forge us into stronger weapons. Right.", 'Raines! You traitor!', "Yeah, we've heard. The destruction of Cocoon.", 'Raines….', 'Maybe. But what about your dad?', 'Off to hell we go.', "You know, if we don't find anything this time, we won't get another chance.", "We understand. You're not gonna go through this ordeal alone, you know.", "This is not an ordeal, this a gift! Hope, this the kind of power you've got inside. And it's telling you not to give up. Trust me.", "So, we're decided then?", "Once we're home, what's you plan? You're getting married, right?", 'Serah wants to know.', "You are getting married, aren't you. Don't let her down, you hear me?", "That's all I need to know.", "It's acting strange.", 'Sounds like it. Somewhere out there on Gran Pulse.', "Yeah, well, it's not all on them. Last time I checked, we are still in this fight.", 'Stop it!', "I didn't think fal'Cie had the means.", 'What did you do to Cocoon?', 'We can jump.', "No. Unlike you, they'll listen to reason.", "Right--over Barthandelus' dead body.", "This is it. A lot of dreams died to get us here, and we can't let it be for nothing.", "Think! Where's the real Serah?", "Could be more fal'Cie smoke and mirrors.", 'We made you go it alone.', 'You were there too, Fang. Same side. All of us. Together to the end.', 'No. We overreach you.', "You don't believe in anything. You gave up on life before you were even born. Sat poisoning Cocoon from the inside, waiting for someone to come and destroy you. Sure, you think the end of the world is salvation. All you care about is death's release. So take it, and leave the rest of us alone. We don't think like that. When we think there's no hope left, we keep looking until we find some. Maybe Cocoon is past saving, but it's our home. And we'll protect it or die trying! We live to make the impossible possible! That is our Focus!", 'They did it, they saved the world.', 'It really is miracle.', "Serah...I'm sorry.", 'I believe you. Congrats.', "Let's get this over with!", 'You know what to do!', 'This should be interesting.', 'No time to waste!', "Cocoon's nothing to you?!", 'Right...', 'Find your own road to hell!', 'Just stay out of my way.', "Let's go!", 'Now!', 'Take down the enemy!', 'Follow my lead!', 'Turn the tide!', "Let's wrap this up!", 'Time to switch it up!', 'You asked for it!', 'Barthandelus!', 'Take this!', 'Out of my way!', 'Stay down!', "You're going down!", 'Target acquired.', 'Thank you.', 'Good call.', "Don't panic.", 'We survive!', "Target's a target.", 'Nothing personal.', 'Time to end it!', 'Take this!', 'Odin...Cut us a path!', 'Clear the field!', "We do this together! Let's ride!", "Lend me your blade! We'll carve out a new fate!", 'Charge!', 'Shake the ground!', "Trample 'em!", 'This ends now!', 'The storm is here!', 'And so it ends...', 'Just... like that?', 'I can win this!', "I'll make it quick.", 'Time to end it!', "I'm no one's slave!", 'You lose.', 'Something to remember.', 'Outta my way!', "It's over!", 'I control my fate!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['This is crazy!', 'Really? Can I?', "Ahhh! It's even worse!", 'Hey, are you serious?!', 'Hey, Snow. Where ya been?']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['Not making a wish, Hope?', 'Who are you calling kid?', 'That next year--your father can come with us.', "I told you, didn't I? Moms are tough.", 'Get him home...Please...']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["Fang, let's go. What's our Focus even matter?", 'What?', "Let's give up! Forget our Focus, we don't need it!", "It's just--making a kid a that young l'Cie. It's not right!", 'Fang?', "Wait! Fang! Fang! Please! Don't leave me!", "I think you'll be fine.", "I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! What else can I say?", 'The thirteen days after we awoke were the beginning of the end.', 'Here.', 'Bang!', 'First impression of Snow? All talk.', 'Come on!  We have to move!', "It's too much, isn't it? Face it later.", 'Ciao!', "You said it made you happy when I smiled, didn't you? But really...I was afraid. I was afraid.", "The Pulse fal'Cie. It held our future...and our fate.", "That was close...Where is the... Oops...Well, then...Guess it's...just us.", 'What do you mean, "finished"?', 'Vanille.', 'My name. And yours?', "What's your problem?", "We'll be okay. Calm down!", "Wait! Who's Serah?", 'Why is she turning into crystal?', "When I couldn't see a future and I was afraid. When the future was clear and it hurt to see, I just close my eyes and lose myself in happier days.", "Really? Okay, and why's that?", "People really hate Pulse, don't they.", "Come on. Let's get going.", "There's still time. You give up too easy, old man!", "Yeah, I'm a kid! I don't understand!", "Let's get you home, okay. Your dad gotta be worried!", "They don't even know why they're scared.", 'I followed the smell.', 'It smells nice. All naturey.', "Come on, Pops! You really got to keep it together, okay? Now-- let's go.", "Being made a l'Cie, it's not easy. I mean, look, even I'm kind of worried. But even if we don't know what'll happen, we have to keep our dreams alive. Have something to look forward to, you know.", "Don't blame yourself. You know, you can't control who a fal'Cie picks for its Focus.", 'Sazh... Do you hate Pulse?', 'Yeah...', 'I might as well have tried to stop the rain. I fought the tears... but they still fell.', "Knowing you'll always be welcomed, no matter how much has changed...That's what having a home is all about.", 'When it comes to family or home, we never keep either as close as we should. Who ever stops to think that this time could be their last?', "It's her!", "I'll let you decide.", 'Yeah, but should we really be playing around.', "Let's look around!", 'The smell reminded me of home. The wildness of Pulse.', 'Part of the gang already.', 'The fun times are doubled, and you worries feel far away.', "My name is Oerba Dia Vanille. I'm a l'Cie from Gran Pulse. And to everyone on Cocoon...Evil. Shoot me! For your son!", "Then what can I do? What do you want from me? If I can't live or die, what do you want me to do?", "I don't know!", 'Sazh....', 'All of Cocoon was against us. With us dead, everyone was sure that things would go back--back to the way it was before.', 'Sazh?', "That's my line. I'm the one who lied to everyone.", "But, if I'd just told the truth--!", 'You mean become Ragnarok.', 'Mr. Hero! Cocoon calling Snow!', 'This place--it must be an Ark.', "I think Raines was searching--searching for a way to make us understand. To understand the frustration of being a l'Cie---a l'Cie bound to a Focus. And maybe... what it meant to be human.", "Same here. I'll help you do it.", 'Fang?', "Hey, Serah... So I guess a l'Cie doesn't have to mean you can't do what's right. Does it?", 'No one ever said the future would be easy. But I think we all saw the glimmer of a dream, somewhere in the sky that night. The tiniest spark of hope that we can change our fate. Who could say? That moment has come and gone.', "A world wild and fragile, vibrant and untamed...Gran Pulse. It's a place where lives are ruled by the brutal struggle for survival and the callous and uncaring whim of the fal'Cie. There is no such thing as mercy...only a never ending string of trials that weed out the weak and leave only the strong. Raines knew the truth...the purpose lying in the heart of the fal'Cies' actions: 'Recalling their lost deity and returning the world to its former glory.' People were never anything more than sacrifices. And Cocoon's destruction? It's just a way to wake a sleeping god. But would bringing back the Maker into this world really lead to our salvation? The Maker created fal'Cie...and they, in their desperation of being reunited with the Maker, created l'Cie. And l'Cie? I wonder what we'll end up creating. Our future looked bleak. But as long as we could keep our spirits up...we'd find a way to change our fate--somehow.", 'But...we could go a little further.', "That's still one place...", "I'm sure.", "I told you. On Gran Pulse, we're all family. You can moan all you like, but you're stuck with us.", "Maybe nothing would change. And maybe we'd dead end. But, we were at least going to see where the road would take us. The search for a home buried in the past. And the faintest glimmer of hope. Our final journey had just begun.", 'Something on you mind?', 'About what? Something complicated?', "Oh, I don't know. How about another lifetime?", 'Yep, busy carving out new tunnels.', "Now you're thinking Grand Pulse style.", 'What are you talking about?', "You're lying.", "Don't say that!", 'I..', 'Fang...', "I'm so sorry.", 'Yes, I promise.', "I think Serah saw the same vision of Ragnarok that we did. Which mean, Dysley had to be lying when he explained her Focus. I think she beat it. She handed Cocoon over to is, and that's what made her turn to crystal!", "I'm not the only one hearing that, am I?", "We can't leave, this is the only way for us to get through. Please! Help us.", 'He saying thanks.', "It's all gone.", "What do you mean, which is ours? All of them. They're all ours.", 'Because ripples can make waves!', "When I was on Cocoon, I wished on those fireworks. I wished to not let anything happen to Cocoon this time. But I shouldn't have wished for that. Wishes aren't enough. Prayers either. This time I'm making a promise: I will keep Cocoon safe. I promise, no matter what.", "Even if we were chasing shadows, our minds were made up. We'd realized along was that choice was the only thing we had left. Maybe we'd fall short. Maybe we'd never even come close. But, someone, someday, would know we tried.", 'If only we could fly!', "You're all crazy!", 'Fang! This thing? Okay!', 'You could have warned me.', 'Little lights. Just like in Oerba.', "You can't! I'll be fine! And you can't forget our promise! We promised to save Cocoon! We promised!", "You're alive.", 'But, where were you?', "We promised, didn't we.", "Anger didn't drive us. We just had things worth fighting for.", "The brand of l'Cie. The symbol of the Focus we all faced. The mark of the fate we all shared. Proof of the promise we all made.", 'Wishes can come true.', 'But not if you just wait for miracles.', 'Ready.', 'Miracles are things we make for ourselves. Here, and now.', "It's easy to lose sight of things in a world as wide as this one. But if you keep going, you're sure to find what you're looking for--sooner or later.", 'We held the light of hope in our hearts, and achieved the impossible. Now we live on, to greet a new dawn.', 'No daydreaming now.', "You're going to regret this!", 'Follow my lead, pops!', 'Keep up, old man!', 'Change is good, pops!', "I'm not all smiles and sunshine!", 'Nice timing.', 'Counting on you, old man!', 'Sazh, oh no!', 'For you!', 'Keep it up!', 'Here we go!', 'Take that!', 'Hey you!', 'Come on!', 'Now things are gonna get ugly!', 'Take this!', "Come on, Hecaton!! Let's go, Hecaton!!", "No one's getting hurt this time!", 'I have to see this through.', 'Alright, here it comes.', 'Now you made me mad.', "We can't give up hope!", 'We can change the future!', 'Sorry!', 'Goodbye!', "I'm just fine!", "Now's our chance!", "Well, that wasn't scary at all.", 'Way to go, Sazh!', 'Yay us!', "Let's see some fireworks!", 'Is it really over?', 'What went wrong?']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["What's it matter? You want to become a monster?", 'Keep your chin up. We know the part that matters. Right? We are enemies of Cocoon. Know what I say? Play the part and raise hell. Might jump-start our memories.', "The fal'Cie. Let's smash it.", "We don't need it? Look, if we don't figure it out and pull it off, you're gonna become a Cie'th.", "Yeah, it's unfair. But guess what? We grin and bear it like good l'Cie or the fal'Cie starts making more. Like that girl the other day. It doesn't matter what our Focus is. We do out, whether we like it or not.", "Say we call it quits. You think these people will let us go? They'll lynch us on the street. Listen, Vanille. We do what we've gotta do and get ourselves off this filthy world, as fast as we can.", "You get out of here first. I'll buy you some time. Now, don't you worry. I'll come and find you, no matter where you go.", "You're not gonna end up a Cie'th.", 'You want to keep breathing? Shut up and come quiet.', "Okay! Time to hunt some l'Cie!", "Don't get all hot and bothered.", "That's some crowd. Gonna need a plan.", "I'm great, you're great, everybody's great. [gives Lightning the phone] Reunion time. Figure out a rendezvous point. Don't sweat it. That line's hyper-encrypted.", "Where do I start? I got a few screws loose. But I'm a I'Cie, same as you. Difference being...I wasn't born on Cocoon. I'm from Grand Pulse. The 'world below' you all hate so much. My partner and I'd turned to crystal there and gone to sleep. But when we came around, here we were. The reason Cocoon in such an uproar is a the same reason you're here now. Vanille and I woke up. When we came out of crystal stasis, we didn't remember our Focus or what we'd done. All we could do was wander Cocoon, looking for what we'd lost. By the time I took care of 'em, Vanille was long gone. After that, Raines and his Cavalry found me. I never stopped searching for Vanille, but I couldn't find her. Her, or our Focus.", "Yeah they would. They'd have to let everyone know that the the big, bad l'Cie can't hurt 'em no more. These Cocoon people—bunch of cowards and blowhards.", "Well, Gran Pulse is just as twisted. 'Cocoon's a nest of vipers, ready to strike', or so I thought.", "Pulse and Cocoon can rot for all I care! If I don't figure out our Focus soon. Vanille's gonna be a Cie'th. I'll tear down the sky if it'll save her.", 'That looks a lot more like bad luck.', 'So, Light...How you figure this makes us lucky?', "Well, good thing Lady Luck's on our side.", 'Believe in Lady Luck now?', "What's Ragnarok?", "That what they called 'em. Long ago, the fal'Cie who made their home on Gran Pulse were afraid of invasion from the outside. As part of their battle preparations, they created an army living weapons. And they stored those weapons in Arks, and they hide the Arks all over the world. Everyone on Gran Pulse knew the legend.", 'Guess it\'s time to "face the peril of our plight." Sounds splendid.', 'Why are you here?', 'You’re a l’Cie!?', 'Well, count me out. If you all want to go it on your own...Then so will I!', "Let Cocoon gets what's coming. They hate us for being l'Cie. What's it to me if they die? Better that than watch a friend go Cie'th! If you don't have the nerve for it, I'll do it myself. Go on alone, get stronger, and smash Cocoon out of the sky!", "You turn Cie'th, and there's no coming back! I'm not...letting it end that way.", "What's he doing here? Come to take pity on me? Come to take care of a broken l'Cie?", "Yeah, 'help.' That's what Eidolons do, they help us. Eidolons are our salvation. If we can't decide what to do next, they come put us out of our misery!", 'Home sweet home. Welcome to Gran Pulse.', 'Vanille! Are you sure?', 'Mention ordeals, and look what comes along!', "Oh, I get. It's here to show you the way. Show what you've got what it takes to get back on your feet and do this thing!", "Listen, funnyman, don't call this place hell, all right?", "It's my fault Gran Pulse ended up like this, isn't it? I remember everything. I became Ragnarok. I scarred Cocoon. And I left Gran Pulse in this mess, It was me.", 'It all came to me. Everything that happened with our Focus. All of it.', "No, it's the truth. It's all my fault.", "I knew something was off. You've been shying away from our Focus even since we woke up on Cocoon.", "I couldn't figure it out, But then it all made sense, after hearing that story from Raines, You already knew. You knew Ragnarok was the name of destruction.", "That is no reason to lie to me! You think that's what I want? You of all people!", "Poor kid, You've had it rough.", "Listen, you're not alone anymore.", "Keep that up and you'll have me crying soon. We have a new family now. We stick together, you hear me?", 'He must be weak from losing his tail.', 'Look!', "Every trace of color. We're chasing shadows. This whole idea of losing our brands is hopeless!", 'Yep. Everyone in the village.', 'Revolutionaries always get called crazy.', "Don't want to get left behind, do ya? Just remember, don't drop the gizmo.", "That's how they get around on Cocoon.", "So, you're just gonna let everything fall to hell. Is that it?", "You heard me. I said I'll do it!", "I made another promise too, To protect my family. Sometimes... You've got choose!", 'Let me go.', "But you can't be!", "Second time now, isn't it?", 'When prayers turn into promises, not even fate can stand in their way.', "Once you're a Cie'th, killing the only thing that comes naturally.", 'Some endorsement, coming from the guardian of all life on Gran Pulse.', 'Goodnight, sunshine!', "You're gonna squirm!", 'Come on then!', 'Eat this!', 'Take that!', 'Appreciated.', 'Cheers!', 'Looking at me?', 'Give it your best shot!', 'Bahamut! You know what to do!', 'Time for dinner!', 'Have some fun!', 'Rain down hell!', 'What a sweetheart!', 'And I was just getting started...', "Didn't even break a sweat!", 'As if there was any doubt!', 'Sorry, Vanille.', 'You kidding me?', 'Ready for this?!', 'No escape!', "Don't be scared!", "Wouldn't wanna be you!", "No one's getting in my way!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['So, Raines, this the Cocoon you dreamed of?', 'Damn idealism! Ya feed it blood, and it howls for more!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ['Dajh.', 'Making a wish, huh? What did you wish for?', 'How about that? Your wish came true!', "Okay, it's my turn to wish.", "That's my little secret.", 'Excuse me. Hey, lady. What gives?', "Really? You don't look ready to go quietly into that good night.", "Now I really want to see what you're up to.", 'Oh goodness. We did it.', "Aren't you supposed to protect civilians, Soldier? I mean, you are Sanctum, aren't ya? What are you doing stopping the Purge? Why don't you tell me that?", "Man...Chocobo, we just can't get a break, can we?", 'Not wanting to be Purged, I get. But taking on trained soldiers?', "Yeah, well, hell isn't sounding too bad. Cause this place isn't exactly paradise.", 'Huh?...Turn ugly?', "So, Soldier...What's your angle? What, is it classified military info? What's the matter? You quit, didn't you? You think I'm gonna go out there and just tell everybody your secret?", "Didn't have a choice...", "It's an out-and-out massacre. Those people won't even live long enough to die on Pulse.", 'What?', "Still won't budge? I think the door is winning.", 'Beg your pardon?', 'Beg your pardon?', 'Oh, blast charge? Hold on, hold on!  Make it happen.', "What the—hey! What did—How'd you open it? After you.", "If those things are still around, might be some soldiers trapped in here, too. Except they'd be l'Cie by now. Not even human anymore. Just Pulse l'Cie. Enemies of Cocoon. Can't show 'em any mercy.", "What's gotten into you, Soldier? I thought you came for a fight.", 'Your sister?', "What? A Pulse l'Cie?", "Listen to me. When a person gets cursed by the fal'Cie, they become l'Cie. Then they get given a Focus, right? How do I put this? If they don't carry it out, l'Cie end up as one of those things. What I'm saying is, if your sister's gone that far...I mean--! She might still--! How can I--? Oh, man There's no way to turn a l'Cie back into human. Even if she completes her Focus, there's no changing her fate. She'll live her life as a fal'Cie slave. Don't make her suffer.", 'Just like the stories say.', "That is how a Focus comes down, people. The fal'Cie? They don't spell it our with clear-cut instructions. All you get is a hazy glimpse. [Light & Snow look at him] Well, that's what they say. You know, legends and all.", 'Say what?', "Yeah, why don't you give us one reason to believe that? One reason.", "The hell it does! You're grasping at straws, son! Pulse fal'Cie are Cocoon's enemies. We just got recruited by one of them. If I were a betting man...I'd put us on the other side.", "I thought they'd be tougher than that. These guys are PSICOM, yeah? Supposed to be cream-of-the-crop.", "So, from what you're telling me, it sounds like a regular old soldier...has got more training than special forces.", "It's not right. Why'd kids have to get dragged into this mess?", "Problem is, you're one of them.", "We want to help Serah too. But without tools...we could be digging for days. The army's on our trail. For now, we've got to keep moving. For now.", "Not hate. More like fear. Tens of millions of people...all scared of Pulse boogeymen. They'd be shaken in their beds every night if they knew...that l'Cie like us were around.", "Get going to where, exactly? The whole of Cocoon's against us. No matter how far we run, there's no escape. That Cie'th clock, it's still tickin'.", "I'm not giving up. But there are some things that you just can't change. A kid like you would not understand.", 'Well, I guess we can be fugitives together.', 'Any father cares.', "Pulse is crawling with things that, isn't it?", "Yeah, I noticed that. But don't you need to know exactly what you're up against?", "You like to keep it simple, don't you?", "This isn't a game!", "All of Cocoon is in the grip of Pulse-phobia. If a l'Cie pops up on the radar, all hell will break lose.", "Afraid of what they don't know. Afraid to find out more. Get worse the older you get. I'm terrified of what will happen. The world probably would be better off without Pulse l'Cie. I mean, most of them.", 'What?', 'Just smells damp. And I think something bit me.', "Now I've got kids looking out for me. Some dad I am.", 'Next stop is Nautilus--City of dreams.', "I'm just thinking.", "My son Dajh. He was picked. He's a l'Cie. He said he wanted to see a fal'Cie. So, I took him on a tour of the Euride Gorge plant. Though I'd surprise him with a chocobo chick to take home, but the second I turned my back...into the energy plant he went Apparently, those Pulse l'Cie had snuck in and tried to attack the Sanctum fal'Cie. It did the only thing it could, and make a Dajh a l'Cie to protect it. My son, he got picked by a Sanctum fal'Cie.", "Why wouldn't I? Look at this mess it gotten us all into! Of course, that's not to say I always hated it. Seemed fishy. All that Sanctum ranting about the 'threat from Pulse'. 'Only a matter of time before they strike'. 'Pulse is infested with monsters'. Scare after scare, and not even a shred of proof. Tired old cynics like me, we don't just swallow that tabloid crap. No, no. Not me. I figured the Sanctum was up to something crooked. At least until I got dragged into it.", "Now that I think about I, all this Pulse business...it really only happened because Dajh found that Pulse fal'Cie.", "Yeah, you're right. It was that scum from Pulse behind it.", "What's wrong?", 'Where to next, little lady?', 'I know! A Nautilus Park date--with Sazh.', 'Forget about that heavy stuff for a while, and maybe this will fade away.', "Dajh's just crazy about chocobos. He really wanted to come here.", 'Indeed. And in we go!', "Dahhh. Ooohh..The smell. Oohh. Glad I don't work here.", 'Hey, come back here!', 'Always good to be among friends.', 'And nothing ever seems as scary when you have some to share it with.', 'Huh?', 'Dajh, why are you here?', 'But...how did you get here?', 'Dajh! Wait! Come back!', 'Dajh...Not you...Not you, Dajh!', 'Vanille...', 'Vanille.', "Don't you even! You think you die and that's that? You think die and everything'll be sugar and rainbows?", "Don't ask me! You figure it out.", "Neither do I. It's over. There's nothing to do. Shooting you won't help. Neither will living.", "Why can't I do it? I got no reason to keep living. I can't even kill you.", "A memorial?! He's a little boy!", "I'm pathetic.", "Forget it. You can't change what's done.", "Now, now, now, I've been thinking. You woke up from being a crystal once. That means Dajh will woke up one day too, right? What was it like? I mean, how did it happen? You were done with your Focus, right?", "Uh-so? What's on the agenda?", 'No, I mean really.', 'Yeah--Lady Bad Luck!', "Guess fal'Cie don't go now down as easy as the rest of us.", "Destroy the fal'Cie Eden, and shatter Cocoon. That's what the vision is telling us more or less. So, we're back to square one. Out of luck.", "Not Cie'th, but monsters all the same.", 'What? Did he complete his focus?', "I have enough of this! Where's the way out!?", "Okay. All right. Let's do it! I'm with you, bad choices and all!", "How long has it been since left Cocoon? Hm? Not a single soul for miles around, not a single clue about this whole l'Cie mess! What I'm saying is, we did well just getting this far.", 'Meaning?', "That's some beast you tamed, I'll tell you that.", "You're never alone in hell.", "Jeesh! I was just kidding! Yeah, I know. You're sticking with me till Daj wakes up. Could be a long wait. No one knows.", 'You watching me or something? Say something, or something!', "You don't have to begin anywhere. What happened to Dajh...wasn't your fault.", "You've got more that enough weight on your shoulders. It was my fault at Euride--letting Dajh out of my sight like that. That one's on me.", "No way through. Man, that fal'Cie must have been slacking.", "It couldn't be them. Could it?", 'Gone just like that. For a big hunk of rock, that thing can move!', 'One heck of a lot of places to hang your hat.', "So, this is the end of the rainbow, huh? Here's hoping the pot full of tips on dealing with crackpot fal'Cie.", 'Guess the jig is up.', 'Okay, kids have gone crazy.', "Oh, okay, I don't know.", 'Nothing to it!', "Yeah? Well, we're gonna stop this ruckus soon enough.", "Why are you doing this, Rosch? I mean, haven't you done enough?", "You said it. It's not just our future we're fighting for.", 'Dajh!', "Hey, listen. It isn't real. It's fal'Cie smoke and mirrors.", 'No. Not anymore.', "I don't know. It was a new Focus, or something. You know, I'm thinking, didn't really make sense of course. I mean, knowing we were worm bait and all, but...As luck would have it, next think I know I feel somebody pushing me right along.", "That's right. Just charge in, guns blazing!", 'Oh great, another one. Nothing like witnessing survival of the fittest first hand.', "Can't we just talk this over?", "Guess running's out of the question?", 'Just as I was getting used to things...', 'We got this, Vanille!', "Follow the old man's lead!", "Changin' the play.", 'Changing gears.', 'Coming through!', 'Watch out!', 'Did you see that coming?', "Bull's eye.", 'Leave it to me!', 'Tough times, huh?', 'Hey now.', "I summon... Brynhildr! There you are. About time you'd showed up.", "Put me behind the wheel! That's right! Let's do this! Eidolon! Start your engines!", 'Time, to warp this up! Come on! Oh yeah!', 'Be seeing ya.', 'You should see your daddy now!', 'Old man still got it.', 'Wisdom does come with age.', 'Dajh.', "Luck's... finally run out.", 'Old man, new tricks.', 'Shoot you full of holes.', 'Wish on these fireworks!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["I don't know. I don't know my Focus. I'm gonna be a monster.", 'Okay.', "If it's true what they say...When we're finished, I'll turn to crystal.", "Don't laugh, okay? It's a dream I had, a bad one. I dreamed I destroyed the world. It was terrifying. I needed some time alone. It had me so scared I tried to run away. But then, my boyfriend, he came chasing after me. That's when I understood. Running away and leaving behind the people you care about? That isn't love. Though you might just want to keep them safe, shutting them out of you life only hurts them more. The point is, I have people I can count on. I'll make it through.", "You will be too. You'll find the words, I'm sure of it.", "I'm not the one you should asking, Vanille. You'll know what to say when you find your friend. You'll see.", "Maybe I was. I was hoping that tomorrow I can tell my sister. She'll be so mad, knowing I hid it from her.", "Stories, huh? L'Cie who fulfill their Focus...they become crystal and gain eternal life.", 'So what will I be? A crystal?', 'Yes.', 'Your wish?', 'Sis...', 'You can save us...protect us all...save Cocoon.', "I'm sorry.", '"": Ragnarok. Come Day of Wrath, O Pulse l\'Cie. Embrace thy fate, thine home to burn. That fallen souls might bare our plea..To hasten the Divine\'s return. O piteous Wanderer, Ragnarok Make of this day a brave epoch. Deliver the Divine, Ragnarok.', '"":  I was waiting for you to open your eyes. All the time I was asleep, I knew what was happening. I kept trying to think a way to save Cocoon-together.', '"": You get it know. There are no gods with miracles to save us, no matter where you look. That\'s why we have to call one. [At a smile is truly evil, just like Galenth as herself] Destroy Orphan. We\'ll save the world!', "It's okay."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["Serah! What is your Focus? L'Cie have a Focus, right? I'll go with you. Help you do it. Just let me.", "I will be with you! No matter what! We've come to far to quit now.", "Not if I'm here. I'll protect you. We'll figure this out--do it together. Okay?", "Don't worry. When l'Cie complete their Focus, they're blessed with the gift of eternity. They wouldn't called it eternity if you died. You'll see. You and me, we'll always be together.", 'Making a wish?', "Don't worry, I'll take the blame for you. You know, you should ask for something bigger. These are wish-granting fireworks like in the stories.", "Would help if they gave you some clue about what you're suppose to do. We'll figure this thing out...You will never be one of those monsters.", "Yesterday at the store, I got you something. Don't know much about jewelry, but I hope you like it.", "I'll stay by you, no matter what happens. I'm yours forever. Serah...my one, my only...will you marry me?", 'She said yes!', 'Gotta love these fireworks. They granted my wish.', 'Before you agree to marry me, I wish on them that you would say yes.', 'Wait! Serah!', "Why won't you believe her?", 'Sister...!', "But you're leaving Serah alone!", "Fine...I'll do it. I'll protect her.", 'Yuj. You stay here.', 'These people need heroes.', "No dirt naps today. We're all in this together. Our enemy's the Cocoon Sanctum. Their dreaded PSICOM, no less.", 'Push comes to shove, keep them safe.', 'No kidding!', 'Hold on!', 'Hey, Gadot.', "If you don't know who you got to save, you just protect them all, right?", "I'll swing by the Vestige. Keep the kids out of trouble!", "Dinner's on me.", "Haha, don't worry. None of you are invited.", 'Catch ya later!', "Okay, listen. Find someplace to hide and keep quiet. Once I find Serah, we'll all leave together You'll be home for dinner.", "Anything, I'll do anything. Just leave it to me. I'll save Cocoon.", 'You just relax.', 'Serah! Serah!', 'I will carry on.', "Serah's a crystal now. You gave her a Focus. And she did it. You got what you want! Now let her go!", "Please. Turn her back! I'll be your l'Cie instead!", 'Lightning!', 'What did I...just do?', 'Watch it!', 'Sorry.', 'Save her.', 'Our Focus is to protect Cocoon.', "We fight it! Ragnarok. That's the we're l'Cie. To stop it--to keep Cocoon safe!", "Serah. She said to protect to Cocoon, and then she turned to crystal. That's the proof right there. She completed her Focus! That means ours is to save Cocoon. Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["L'Cie dwell outside the natural order. Should their strength fail them, they become the mindless foes of life itself.", "Fortune smiles upon the strong and worthy. Surrender not to despair. The future of life's cycle goes with you."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII
Dialogues: ["Attention all units. This is Director Rosch, PSICOM division. Cocoon is caught in the grip of a Pulse-born Terror. If we allow l'Cie activity to continue, panic will rip our world apart. The peace and stability we have fought so hard to maintain will be nothing but a memory. These Pulse l'Cie threaten our very way of life. They must be eliminated. There can be no hesitation. That is all.", 'If we fail, our citizens will pay the price.', "You must be Snow Villiers. Yaag Rosch, PSICOM Division. I understand your plight. However, the Pulse threat is not so easily dismissed. The very existence of you l'Cie puts every last one of us in danger. Tell me, do you really think your life is worth more than the lives of millions of Cocoon citizens? I do not. And so it fall to me to order your execution. It's that simple. It is my responsibility to see you put down. Your lives are forfeit.", 'Do you think we want to Purge our own people? If any trace of Pulse remains, the populace will erupt into chaos. Without sacrifice. without the Purge, Cocoon will die!', 'I see your power has grown, Mr Villiers. No matter. We will lay down our lives if that what it takes to stop you.', "Nevertheless, you are l'Cie. [enters the Proudclad] We can trust the pawns no more the fal'Cie who move them. Humanity's fate rests in its own hands!", "Enough? Under fal'Cie order, I've orchestrated murder. All to answers the fears of a panicked populace. For a people utterly dependent on the fal'Cie it was the only solution I could offer. Even if that solution was a farce.", "You're right. One thing remains. This is...this is PSICOM Director Rosch. Attention all PSICOM and Guardian Corps units. Suspend l'Cie operation. I repeat, suspend l'Cie operation. All units should focus their efforts on evacuating civilian population. I do not issue this order as an absolute. You are free to make the choice.", "These are l'Cie. Show no mercy. They aren't people. They're targets.", "Cocoon is caught in the grip of a Pulse-born Terror. These Pulse l'Cie threaten our very way of life. They must be eliminated. Over and out.", "Who do you think it is terrified of Pulse and begging us to kill the l'Cie? It's not Sanctum. It's not us. It's the people.", "Not so fast, I'Cie!"]
